## Goal
The wisp reaper (internal/reaper/reaper.go, hourly from internal/daemon/wisp_reaper.go) and `gt reaper scan` read the wisps tables by SQL, and a tracker rig is absent from their discovery. The tracker stores ephemeral rows (the contract cases list them); give trackerd and its client a read for them: list ephemeral issues by status, closed-before and created-before cutoffs with a page cursor, plus a count, so the reaper port (next beads) has a data source. Read tracker/store/postgres_list.go first and extend its filter; add the matching request fields in tracker/api/requests.go and the client method in tracker/client/issues.go.

## Constraints
- Files: tracker/api/requests.go, tracker/store/postgres_list.go, tracker/server/routes_issues.go, tracker/client/issues.go and their tests (the store test runs under the container gate).
- No delete here: purge is the next bead.

## Out of scope
Deleting rows, the reaper policy, the daemon.

## Gate
go test ./tracker/...

## Size
one worker, one MR

## Acceptance

- [x] a store test shows list by status and age cutoffs returns the expected ephemeral rows and pages with a cursor
- [x] a client test against the in-process server shows the count matches the list length
- [x] a test shows non-ephemeral issues are never returned by this read
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] a store test shows list by status and age cutoffs returns the expected ephemeral rows and pages with a cursor
- [x] a client test against the in-process server shows the count matches the list length
- [x] a test shows non-ephemeral issues are never returned by this read
notes:
Landed the read Mo3b purges from; no delete here.

- api.ListFilter gains ClosedBefore and CreatedBefore (strictly before; zero is no bound; an issue with a NULL close time never matches a close bound).
- New CountIssues store method, POST /v1/issues:count ({filter: ListFilter} -> {count: n}) and client.Count. The count is the whole match: a filter carrying limit or cursor is refused as invalid at the route and again in the store.
- Wisp reads are List with Ephemeral true (postgres pins issues.ephemeral = $n, so a durable issue can never come back), Statuses (["closed"] or ["all"]), the cutoffs, Limit and Cursor.
- Tests: contract cases_wisp.go (age cutoffs both directions, cursor walk, count vs list length, durable issue never returned, page refused) run under the container gate; unit tier covers the WHERE builder, the route refusal and client<->route agreement.

dependencies.description:
## Goal
Replace the Dolt-backed bd tracker with a town-owned Postgres service (trackerd) for the verbs the town uses, behind the existing beads.Client seam, with a bd shim for rig-by-rig migration.

## Design and plan
docs/plans/2026-10-25-town-tracker-design.md and docs/plans/2026-10-25-town-tracker-plan.md (landing via gt-gfmn3). Handoff bead: claude-477 in ~/.claude. Decisions were grilled with Sloan on 2026-10-25 (Q1-Q16, all accepted).

## Tracks
R research, B seam bypasses, C crew foundation (not polecat), E polecat image, V verbs, M migration, Mo wisps and molecules, X shim, O ops, A ADRs. The interim Dolt track (D) is run by the crew session and the overseer, not polecats.

## Rules
Polecat beads add to existing packages only: no schema change, no new dependency. The crew tasks C1-C6 create the module, schema and dependencies first. Tests follow ~/.claude/docs/standards/test-engineering.md.
